Monologue: What interesting times we are living in, friend. I thought you had it in you to find some way of saving those kids.
Having to listen to their nonsense of horsemen irritated me to no end—as if I were on the level of those *children*.
Oh, how I made those twins *scream*.
No need to feel bad, friend. No one will miss those arrogant brats.
I don't mind if you hate me. In fact, I would prefer you do. To what degree do I need to go to break your silence astounds me.
You see, friend, I am here to learn more about this city on behalf of my…superiors. The Spoilage here is something they are greatly interested in.
I watch, just like you, of all the folks who live and breathe in this city. When I act, it is to *experiment*. But I am now finished.
You can return to your work in peace. This is our final goodbye, friend. There's not much left. I hope you enjoy the ride of what's left.
